text:
alex: Quick broadcast: putting v3.5.0 release train on HOLD for 1.5h. We got a high-severity SCA alert for a transitive dependency used by the runtime loader. Dont cut any release branches or promote builds until we clear the alert.

sec_alerts: Security alert: SCA-high CVE-2026-0421 affecting libfastload v1.2.3 -> please see ticket: https://security.redwood.ai/alerts/1972345678 (internal). Remediation recommended: patch to libfastload v1.2.5 or apply runtime loader sandboxing.

sasha: Acknowledged. Ill run quick impact scan across dedicated pools and private installs to see which customers could be affected. ETA 20m.

deploy-bot: Release hold applied: release=v3.5.0 state=HOLD reason=security-sca initiated_by=alex expires_in=01:30

lee: Does this block canaries too? We had 10% canary already on us-west.

alex: Yes, pause canaries immediately and stop any canary traffic. Keep observability-only traffic (metrics/traces) if possible.

infra-runner: Command to pause canary traffic: ```
# pause canary traffic for v3.5.0
redwoodctl traffic pause --release v3.5.0 --scope=canary
```

sasha: Quick update: scan complete - only hosted and dedicated pools running runtime-loader v2.8.x with libfastload v1.2.3. Private customer images look unaffected (they bundle v1.2.5).

lee: For hosted pools, can we apply runtime sandboxing as a mitigation until we bump the dependency?

alex: Yes, sandboxing is acceptable short-term. sasha and lee pair on the sandbox toggle. After sandboxing, we'll re-run smoke tests and then consider a controlled promote.

sec_alerts: Mitigation notes posted to ticket: sandbox-mode reduces attack surface but may increase cold-start by ~12-18ms and memory overhead.

sasha: I'm toggling sandbox on a single canary host now, will report perf impact in 8m.

deploy-bot: Sandbox toggle event: release=v3.5.0 host=canary-04 action=enable initiated_by=sasha

alex: Action items:
- sasha: toggle sandbox across canary hosts, collect perf delta (8m)
- lee: prepare dependency bump PR for libfastload -> v1.2.5 and run CI smoke suite
- infra-runner: keep hold flag enabled until security sign-off
- deploy-bot: record hold and attach alerts ticket to release metadata

lee: PR Draft: https://git.redwood.ai/r/runtime/+/PR-431 (work in progress). CI queued.

sasha: Sandbox on canary-04: tail latency +15ms p95, CPU +6%. Error rate unchanged. Keeping sandbox on for now.

alex: Good. If CI is green and runtime tests pass, we can roll the dependency patch to canary and re-evaluate. Tentative resume after 1.5h or earlier if patch lands and tests pass.

infra-runner: Holding automated merges into release branches and notifying CI to deprioritize non-security jobs.

lee: CI passed unit + integration but one flaky e2e failing (timing). Rerunning focused e2e.

sec_alerts: Security sign-off pending confirmation of libfastload v1.2.5 deployment in canary and dedicated pools.

alex: I'll post a resumption notice when we have sign-off. For now, treat this as HIGH-PRIORITY hold. Ping in thread with any urgent findings :lock:

sasha: Will update in 10m with patch status and perf numbers.

alex: Thanks all.
